user.title: EMS
user.description:
The EMS needs no hardware: PV, grid, battery, heat pump, cars and consumers are assigned afterwards in the sidebar under EMS → Settings.

Optional: enter the IP address of a Rennergy smart1 controller to add its heating values and controls (Modbus TCP must be enabled). This can also be done later in the settings.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Rennergy. Check IP address, port and that Modbus TCP is enabled. Leave the field empty to set up the EMS without it.
error.no_items: Connected, but no values were found. Use "Auto Address" in the Modbus configuration of the controller.

abort.already_configured: The EMS is already set up. Change everything in the sidebar under EMS → Settings.

set_manual.name: Set to manual
set_manual.description: Switches EMS items to manual mode and sets a value. With a duration the item returns to automatic afterwards (survives restarts).

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: EMS switches, sliders or mode selects.

value.name: Value
value.description: New value, e.g. 0-100 %. Switches: above 0 = on. Optional for switches (default on).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: After this many minutes the item returns to automatic. Empty = stays manual.

set_auto.name: Set to automatic
set_auto.description: Hands EMS items back to the controller's automatic and stops a running timer.

entity_id.description: EMS switches, sliders or mode selects.
